title: A protocol for high-throughput screening of histone lysine demethylase 4 inhibitors using TR-FRET assay
protocol: Dispense 10 μL/well of H3K9Me0-Biotin, H3K9Me1-Biotin, H3K9Me2-Biotin or H3K9Me3-Biotin at 200 nM or 500 nM in a 384-well black low volume assay plate.
Dispense 10 μL/well of Tb-anti-H3K9Me2 (4 nM) and AF488-Streptavidin (40 nM).
Set the mixture still and incubate for 30 min at room temperature (18°C–22°C).
Detect TR-FRET signals (fluorescence emission ratio of 10,000 × 520 nm/490 nm) using a PHERAstar FS plate reader.
Incubate 2 nM Tb-anti-H3K9Me2 and 20 nM AF488-Streptavidin at 20 μL/well with 1:2 dilutions of the substrate peptide H3K9Me3-Biotin or resulting product peptide H3K9Me2-Biotin for 30 min.
Detect TR-FRET signals of each group.
Reconstitute Tb-anti-H3K9Me2 antibody to the resulting product peptide H3K9Me2-Biotin at all tested concentrations.
Test three different buffers (buffer 1 to 3) for assay specificity.
Formulate an optimal assay buffer based on results from initial testing of three buffers.
Dispense 10 μL/well of H3K9Me3-Biotin (1.5 μM) in a 384-well assay plate.
Add 5 μL/well of KDM4B at concentrations of 0 nM, 750 nM, 1.5 μM, 2.25 μM or 3 μM.
Incubate the assay plate for 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 or 90 minutes at a temperature range of 18°C–22°C.
Dispense 5 μL/well of 8 nM Tb-anti-H3K9Me2 antibody.
Dispense 80 nM AF488-Streptavidin in 5 μL/well.
Incubate for an additional 15 minutes.
Detect TR-FRET signals.
Dispense 10 μL/well of 1.5 μM H3K9Me3-Biotin peptide solution in an assay buffer to black low volume 384-well assay plates.
Briefly spin down the assay plates.
Dispense stock compound solutions from both compound plate and control plate using a robotic pintool at 30 nL/well (primary single dose screen) or 140 nL/well (dose response test).
Assay each compound in triplicates.
Dispense 5 μL/well assay buffer to columns 1 and 13, and 5 μL/well KDM4B (750 nM) in an assay buffer to columns 2-to-12 and 14-to-24 for the primary single dose screen.
Dispense 5 μL/well assay buffer to columns 23-to-24, and 5 μL/well KDM4B (750 nM) in an assay buffer to columns 1-to-22 for the dose response test.
Mix contents in each assay plate by shaking.
Briefly spin down each assay plate.
Incubate the plates for 30 minutes without shaking at 18°C–22°C.
Dispense 5 μL/well of 8 nM Tb-anti-H3K9Me2 antibody to the incubated assay plates.
Add 80 μM AF488-Streptavidin to each well.
Shake the plates after addition of antibodies and streptavidin.
Briefly spin down the plates again.
Incubate the plates for 15 minutes at 18°C–22°C protected from light.
Detect the TR-FRET signal (fluorescence emission ratio of 10,000 × 520 nm/490 nm) in each well using a PHERAstar FS plate reader.
Analyze activity of each tested compound by normalizing its TR-FRET signal to that of positive and negative controls in each plate for the primary screen.
Analyze activities of each chemical at different concentration levels using GraphPad PRISM software.
Fit dose response data into a sigmoidal dose-response equation to derive dose-response curve and IC50 value if applicable.
